lane_flags.en: Semiconductor manufacturing or test equipment and specially designed parts may be strategic goods in Singapore (control list category 3B). Each export or re-export of a listed item needs an XO/XP permit applied for at least five working days ahead, even under an ATA Carnet. (HS 9031.41)
lane_flags.mitigation_en: Classify each item against the Strategic Goods Control List (the 2026 Order applies from 1 Dec 2026); obtain the OEM's export classification and the origin country's licence; build 5 working days into the return plan.
lane_flags.mitigation_zh: 按战略物资管制清单逐项归类（2026 年版自 12 月 1 日起适用）；向原厂取得出口管制分类及原产国许可；回运计划预留 5 个工作日。

lane_flags.en: Export controls of the origin country (for example on temporary exports of tools of trade or on returns after repair) were not assessed. (HS 9031.41)
lane_flags.mitigation_en: Ask the equipment owner's trade-compliance team for the export classification and any licence exception before booking.
lane_flags.mitigation_zh: 订舱前由设备所有方贸易合规团队确认出口管制分类及可用的许可例外。
lane_flags.zh: 原产国出口管制（如工具类临时出口、维修后回运的许可要求）未作评估。（HS 9031.41）

lane_flags.en: Goods must leave Singapore in the same condition within the permitted period (6 months for TIS and ATA); selling or leaving them behind triggers GST.
lane_flags.mitigation_en: Track re-export dates; file extensions before expiry.
lane_flags.mitigation_zh: 跟踪复出口日期，到期前申请延期。
lane_flags.zh: 货物须在许可期限内（TIS 与 ATA 均为 6 个月）以原状离境；出售或滞留将产生 GST。

en: Recommended: Cross-border road + Temporary Import Scheme at USD 3,695 per move landed, P90 28.1 days, 96.5% on time against the 30-day target, risk score 59/100.
It meets the 95% on-time requirement and has the best weighted score of cost, P90 time and risk among the options that do.
Sensitivity: with a 24-day target the same option would be on time 60.5% of the time.
Alternative on the Pareto front: Air freight + Temporary Import Scheme - 1% less per move, P90 29.5 days (+1.4), risk 64; on time 91.8% (below target).
Not offered: ATA Carnet - Singapore accepts foreign carnets only for exhibitions, professional equipment and scientific equipment; repair is not one of them.

Conditions to manage: [SG-STRATEGIC-SCREEN] Semiconductor manufacturing or test equipment and specially designed parts may be strategic goods in Singapore (control list category 3B). Each export or re-export of a listed item needs an XO/XP permit applied for at least five working days ahead, even under an ATA Carnet. (HS 8414.10) [ORIGIN-EXPORT-CONTROL] Export controls of the origin country (for example on temporary exports of tools of trade or on returns after repair) were not assessed. (HS 8414.10) [ORIGIN-REIMPORT-REGIME] Re-import into Malaysia after repair (duty/tax relief on return) was not assessed. [TIS-ORIGIN-SIDE] TIS covers only the Singapore side; the return into Malaysia needs that country's own temporary-export or goods-returned procedure, which was not verified. An ATA Carnet covers both ends where both countries accept it.
zh: 推荐方案：跨境公路 + 临时进口计划（TIS）。每次往返落地成本 3,695 美元，P90 时效 28.1 天，30 天内送达概率 96.5%，风险评分 59/100。
该方案满足 95% 准时率要求，并在满足要求的方案中成本、P90 时效与风险的加权得分最优。
敏感性：若时效目标收紧至 24 天，该方案准时率为 60.5%。
帕累托前沿上的备选：空运 + 临时进口计划（TIS）——每次往返成本低 1%，P90 29.5 天（多 1.4 天），风险 64；准时率 91.8%（未达目标）。
未纳入：ATA 单证册——新加坡仅接受外国单证册用于展览、专业设备和科学设备，该用途不在其列。

需重点管控：【SG-STRATEGIC-SCREEN】半导体制造或测试设备及其专门设计的部件在新加坡可能属于战略物资（管制清单 3B 类）。清单内物项每次出口或再出口均须至少提前五个工作日申领 XO/XP 许可证，即使使用 ATA 单证册亦然。（HS 8414.10） 【ORIGIN-EXPORT-CONTROL】原产国出口管制（如工具类临时出口、维修后回运的许可要求）未作评估。（HS 8414.10） 【ORIGIN-REIMPORT-REGIME】维修后复进口马来西亚的关税/税费减免未作评估。 【TIS-ORIGIN-SIDE】TIS 仅覆盖新加坡一侧；货物返回马来西亚须按该国临时出口或退运货物程序办理（未经核实）。若两国均接受，ATA 单证册可同时覆盖两端。
